# Ocala Excavation Pros

> Excavation and land clearing contractor serving Ocala and Marion County, Florida: land clearing, forestry mulching, lot clearing, grading, site prep, trenching, ponds, driveways, tree and stump removal, and small-structure demolition. Free on-site estimates, written quotes delivered within 24 hours of the site walk.

## Contact
- Phone: (352) 790-4301
- Email: quotes@ocalaexcavationpros.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am to 6pm
- Free estimate form: https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/contact.html

## Service area
Ocala, Silver Springs Shores, Marion Oaks, Belleview, Summerfield, Dunnellon, Anthony, Citra, and the rest of Marion County, FL. Nearby jobs in Levy, Citrus and Alachua County when the schedule allows.

## Services
- [Land clearing](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/land-clearing.html): trees, palmetto, stumps and haul-off for lots and acreage
- [Forestry mulching](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/forestry-mulching.html): one machine mulches brush and small trees on site, no burn piles or haul-off
- [Lot clearing for new construction](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/lot-clearing.html): build-ready lots in Ocala, Marion Oaks and Silver Springs Shores
- [Brush and underbrush removal](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/brush-removal.html): overgrowth cleared while your trees stay
- [Pasture and fence line clearing](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/pasture-clearing.html): horse farms and ag land
- [Right-of-way and easement clearing](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/right-of-way-clearing.html): access roads, utility and drainage easements
- [Tree and stump removal](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/tree-stump-removal.html): selective takedowns, stump grinding, stump excavation
- [Land grading and leveling](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/land-grading.html): regrading, drainage correction, laser-leveled pads and arenas
- [Site preparation](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/site-prep.html): cleared, filled, compacted building pads
- [Residential excavation](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/residential-excavation.html): foundations, pools, additions, stem walls
- [Trenching and utility lines](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/trenching.html): water, electrical conduit, septic runs, drainage pipe
- [Pond and drainage excavation](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/pond-excavation.html): farm ponds, retention areas, swales, culverts
- [Driveway installation and repair](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/driveway-installation.html): limerock and gravel drives
- [Demolition and removal](https://ocalaexcavationpros.com/demolition-removal.html): mobile homes, sheds, barns, pools, concrete slabs
